integrity: All claimed implications are proved from Möbius inversion and the cited source definitions. Finite computations were used only as replay checks and for the explicit sharpness example, not as substitutes for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved for finite rooted-forest posets, equivalently finite posets in which every nonminimal element has a unique lower cover. It is not asserted for posets with merge points. An equivalent theorem could exist in older literature under different terminology.
title: Rooted forests collapse Möbius convex order to hockey-stick tests with sharp TV control
